strength: Sides are already balanced (gap 2.2 points, skill gap +73) and the game is very cheap to make (49 cards).
weakness: The crown stalls (1.15 lead changes, up to 30% of games decided by a tiebreak at the centre) and the lead choice is solved, so the middle is dull and the ending arbitrary.
required_changes: Remove or fix the lead choice (alternate the lead or make leading valuable). KPI: lead-side win rate 40-60% in the mirror; casual/family/story bot win rates up toward 45-55%.
Raise lead changes to at least 2 per game (try stronger trailer draws, a leader bonus or a shorter track) while keeping the side gap at or under 5 and runaway leader at or under 65%.
Make round 7 decisive so under 8% of games are decided by a tiebreak at position 0.
Raise the margin rules to 3 and 4 or delete them (they are currently inert).
Resolve all 8 listed ambiguities (Hush on Spend, Retort after pass, margin-blocked win and the next chooser, Echo on ties, position-0 tiebreak, passing again after Retort). KPI: zero ambiguities.
Cut rules weight to about one page (panel rules_simplicity is 0.025); casual/family predicted fun up from about 2.9 toward 3.3.
Give the Whisperer a plan once the deck runs dry (no reshuffle), and recheck the skill-dependent side balance.
revision_reason: Side balance and skill expression already pass and the problems are rules-level and well diagnosed, so a revision can realistically fix lead changes and the lead choice; expect a game for competitive players rather than casual ones.
